description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of tokens and the number of code retrievals for different sources of code documentation. The x-axis, labeled "Number of Tokens," is a linear scale ranging from 200 to 900 tokens. The y-axis, labeled "Number of Code Retrievals," is also a linear scale ranging from 10 to 40 retrievals. The plot includes four lines representing different sources: Tutorials (blue line with circle markers), Library Documentation (red line with square markers), StackOverflow posts (yellow line with diamond markers), and Github files (green line with triangle markers). The Tutorials line starts at approximately 25 retrievals at 200 tokens, peaks at around 35 retrievals at 600 tokens, and ends at about 30 retrievals at 900 tokens. The Library Documentation line begins at roughly 20 retrievals, peaks at around 30 retrievals at 600 tokens, and ends at about 25 retrievals at 900 tokens. The StackOverflow posts line starts at approximately 30 retrievals, peaks at around 35 retrievals at 600 tokens, and ends at about 20 retrievals at 900 tokens. The Github files line begins at roughly 15 retrievals, peaks at around 25 retrievals at 600 tokens, and ends at about 10 retrievals at 900 tokens.
